meta_title: Emergency Anytime Plumbing & Heating | Plumber Newcastle
meta_description: Emergency Anytime Plumbing and Heating offer fast, reliable plumbing and heating services across Newcastle. Available 24/7 — call now for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe, boiler breakdown, or blocked drain — we're on call day and night to fix it fast.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we cover every plumbing and heating need for homes and businesses throughout Newcastle and the surrounding areas.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, and sudden plumbing failures dealt with fast — any time of day or night. We aim to reach you within 60 minutes so damage is kept to an absolute minimum.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: No heating or hot water is miserable, especially in a Newcastle winter. Our engineers diagnose and repair all major boiler brands, with annual servicing to keep your system running safely and efficiently.

services.title: Boiler Installations
services.desc: Whether you're upgrading an old inefficient boiler or fitting a brand-new system, we supply and install energy-efficient models with full warranties. We'll advise on the right boiler for your home and budget.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: From radiator replacements and power flushing to full central heating installations, we'll ensure your home stays warm all year round. We work on all types of systems, including underfloor heating.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Blocked drains cause mess and stress — we clear them quickly using professional-grade equipment with minimal disruption. We handle everything from blocked sinks and toilets to main drain clearances.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause serious structural damage if left untreated. We use modern detection techniques to pinpoint the source accurately and carry out a lasting repair to protect your property.

about_pullquote: We started this business to be the plumber Newcastle can actually rely on.
about_para_1: Emergency Anytime Plumbing and Heating was founded with a straightforward mission: to provide Newcastle homeowners and businesses with a genuinely reliable plumbing and heating service, available whenever they need it. Too many people have been let down by tradespeople who don't turn up or can't respond in a crisis — we built our business to be different.
about_para_2: We take pride in honest pricing, tidy workmanship, and treating every property with the same care we'd give our own. Our customers come back to us because they know they'll get a straight answer, a fair quote, and a job done right — whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned installation.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called at 11pm with a burst pipe and someone was at my door within the hour. Absolute lifesaver — sorted the problem quickly, no mess left behind, and the price was very fair for an emergency call-out. Couldn't recommend more highly.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in on one of the coldest mornings of the year. Emergency Anytime had an engineer with us by 8am and it was fixed before lunch. Friendly, professional, and reasonably priced. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark R.

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Got a same-day appointment for a blocked drain that two other plumbers had failed to sort properly. Cleared it in no time and explained exactly what had caused the problem. Really impressed.
reviews.author: Diane W.
